meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查 Codex 与 LazyCodex 安装,揪出过时或损坏的配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用 LazyCodex 或 Codex,想确认本地安装健康、与最新版一致。
copy.tagline_en: Check Codex and LazyCodex installs for drift, staleness, or breakage.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and worry your local install may be unhealthy or outdated.

howto.what: 检查本地 LazyCodex 与 Codex CLI 安装，先同步最新源码再逐项比对，输出 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告，每条结论都附命令输出或文件作证据。它只做诊断，不改动你的安装、配置或仓库；修复建议需你明确要求后才执行。
howto.when: 当你要求做 doctor 或健康检查，提到 LazyCodex、omo-codex 等关键词，或安装、更新、改配置后 Codex 表现异常、怀疑安装过期损坏时触发。

say.text: 帮我跑一次 LazyCodex doctor，看看装得对不对
say.note: 先同步最新源码，再逐项检查并出报告

say.text: 刚更新完 Codex，行为有点怪，帮我查一下
对比本地安装和最新 LazyCodex 源码有没有漂移
say.note: 列出漂移项并给出两边路径

howto.what_en: Checks your local LazyCodex and Codex CLI install against freshly synced upstream sources and prints a PASS/WARN/FAIL report where every verdict cites command output or a file. Diagnosis only; it never changes your install, and fixes run only if you ask.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a doctor or health check, mention LazyCodex, omo-codex and similar names, or Codex misbehaves after an install, update, or config change.

say_en.text: Run a LazyCodex doctor and tell me if my install is right
say_en.note: Syncs latest sources, then checks each item

say_en.text: Codex acts odd after my update, please look into it
Compare my local install against the latest LazyCodex source
say_en.note: Lists drift items with both paths
